label_contract: Author-reviewed source-grounded current-task preferences. Multiple acceptable progress routes retained. USE_VIEW means inspect, not trust. REFRESH labels assess supplied scope, not guaranteed executor success. Ready HANDOFF is an immediate-task cost preference, not an optimal future-workload label.
qualifications: 43/64 view stages have task-adequate literal facts; this is not graph/state correctness.
Some task-adequate views retain invalid/redundant rules or irrelevant timestamp errors, recorded in review.
Non-exhaustive reviewed source proof sets may omit alternative proofs; preference mismatch is not automatically task error.
Own-policy task rollouts and expanded families remain required after this trial.
Six E0 histories excluded from fitting; no holdout loaded.
